name: bank.accounts
description: Read your own bank savings accounts; login uses your email OTP. Optionally choose a configured bank alias.

bank.description: Configured bank alias, such as south-bank or north-bank; omit for the default bank.

name: bank.cards
description: Read your own bank cards. Optionally choose a configured bank alias.

bank.description: Configured bank alias, such as south-bank or north-bank; omit for the default bank.

name: bank.card_payments
description: Read your own card payment history, including payment platform, actual recipient, description, amount and bank debit transaction ID.

name: bank.products
description: List account products available at your bank. No account is opened.

bank.description: Configured bank alias; omit for the default bank.

name: bank.open_account
description: Open a zero-balance bank account for yourself. Reuse the same UUID and productId when retrying an uncertain result. This does not deposit money.

bank.description: Configured bank alias; omit for the default bank.

id.description: A UUID for this application; reuse it on retry.

name: bank.issue_card
description: Apply for a simulated debit card linked to your own active bank account. Reuse the same UUID and accountId on retry. The card shares the account balance and does not create money.

bank.description: Configured bank alias; omit for the default bank.

id.description: A UUID for this application; reuse it on retry.
